title: Check the caller contract and owner lifetime before repairing a helper
applies_when: An excerpt alleges descriptor/global, identity/cache, self-comparison, field-loss or cleanup defects but omits the helper, ordered result assembly, interface or invoking owner.
lesson: Read the caller contract and owner lifetime first. Check descriptors, __main__, platform predicates, strong references and invalidation; inspect cleanup/reset tests beyond the excerpt. Skipping a spread does not remove ...result's fields. Test empty/nonempty and success paths. SDK cancellation can leave an outer retry alive. Failed upload Writers need abort, not partial-data commit: cancel an upload-owned context, preserving caller authority and successful Close. Invented APIs are feature changes; profile matching is not topology support. Use evidence to choose the next check, not blanket rejection.
avoid_when: Public helpers can be defective without shipped callers. Strong references prevent identity reuse, not mutation/stale metadata/concurrency. Passing cleanup tests prove reached scenarios only. Spreads preserve present enumerable properties; later overwrites or changed producers can lose data. Do not transfer upload abort to caller-owned successful streams. SDK-internal stack checks are revision-bound. These cases do not measure accelerator performance or general false-positive rates.

evidence.note: v7.26.8 rejects responses without x-reqid/x-log as ErrMaliciousResponse. Supply valid fixture headers: plain200/JSON is not an SDK success. Do not disable validation or attribute fixture retries to production.

v7.26.8 Stat/StatWithOpts, Copy/Delete use Background with no context argument. List forwarding cannot fix them. Separately test a context-aware API integration; no invented WithContext or detached early return.

Real GCS SDK/local HTTP: Reader errors before/after a chunk leak Writer monitors; child-context cancellation aborts without partial commit or caller cancellation. Empty/small/multi-chunk success remains. Native/race checks use an SDK-internal stack frame, not live GCS or throughput qualification.

Qiniu/Dragonfly reject 404/416/500 with nil body: callers cannot close the response. Held-open HTTP tests reproduce missing cleanup; rejected-only Close fixes it while 200/206 streams remain caller-owned. Blanket defer would break success. Native/race coverage is local HTTP, not cloud accounts, connection reuse, all statuses or performance.

Request authority and acknowledgement ownership differ: rejecting a second session's hooks does not revoke its admitted request. Native controls cover revocation/one-shot acknowledgement, not service restarts/all timelines.

Initial snapshot L469 is reacquired at L477. Unchanged archive-only/missing-source controls agree; a new archive invalidates the old view. Deliberate freshness, not forgotten archives; not full migration/concurrency qualification.
handle_async_request catches BaseException and shields _response_closed; the iterator also closes on exception at L579-585. A StreamReset-only excerpt omits owning cleanup.
The native RST_STREAM test follows rejection with a successful same-connection request, beyond the first 100 lines. Relevant control, not universal semaphore/cancellation proof.

torchrun initializes global rank before join/update_weights call check_sglang_ready. An import-only call or first-120-line excerpt misses the supported entry. Static, not distributed execution evidence.
get_supported_act_dtypes is an abstract instance method regardless of receiver spelling.
The loader calls quant_config's instance; class-only TypeError is not this caller's regression.

forward_extend retains forward_batch in outer metadata while checking identity/resolving the next result. Omitting that reference fabricates id reuse. Revision-bound source evidence, not NPU execution.

Windows sameRuntimeIdentity requires nonzero dev/ino: self-comparison can fail for unavailable identity. assertPrevious checks the retained object after rename. Not dead code or all-platform/filesystem-race qualification.

migrated spreads before combined notices. Empty collected.notices preserves migrated.notices; the conditional alone fabricates field loss. Ordered-expression evidence, not full Doctor/migration coverage.
The outer catch records plugin/runtime JSON.parse failures, failed step and status=error. Ending at L481 omits it. Static counterexample, not native coverage or ideal diagnostics.
resolve matches shapes then validates capacity; a shape-only supports method cannot replace capacity checks or prove hardware support.
The request permits support-query OR documented fallback plus validated profiles; no invented API mandate or backend-correctness proof.

Real S3 SDK requests stop on cancellation, but ListAll's outer page retry survives. Cancel/deadline/backoff negatives and a transient 503 recovery control test the separate producer lifetime. Proposed narrow fix covers draining receivers and nil failure sentinel; not blocked consumers, token recovery, delimiter/sharded paths or all backends. Native/race tests, no performance claim.

Earlier closed, unmerged pagination proposal already covers retry cancellation plus token recovery/backoff. Do not claim the mechanism is new or ignore prior work; the narrow regression above does not qualify those broader changes.
